title: Hula 7000 Pink Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Hula 7000 Pink Lemonade Prefilled pod recreates the familiar sparkle of classic Lemonade, brightened with a gentle berry sweetness. The sharp zest of Lemon runs through every puff, while subtle red fruit notes add a light, refreshing lift to the finish. These Hula Prefilled Replacement Pods are designed for the Hula Prefilled Pod System Kit, providing a mess-free way to replace flavours. Each unit contains a 2ml draw-activated pod that is continuously replenished by an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, keeping your vape topped up with no bottles or coil changes needed. Together, the 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt offers up to 7000 puffs (approx.), powered by dual mesh coil technology for consistent flavour and vapour production. Just insert into your Hula device and enjoy a long-lasting Pink Lemonade vape with ease. Available in 20 satisfying flavours, these replacement pods are perfect for keeping your vape fresh and flavourful.
